name: USGS Historical Statistics for Mineral and Material Commodities
known_limitations: Commodity files end in different years and contain unit changes, revisions, withheld values, and series breaks; blank cells are not zero.
automation_notes: Preserve commodity, table, update year, units, definitions, revisions, missingness, and series breaks.
notes: Long-run production, trade, stocks, consumption, end-use, and unit-value rail for nearly 90 commodities.
